title: Monotonic Stack
summary: Keep only unresolved candidates in monotonic value order so a new item can resolve dominated candidates exactly when their boundary becomes known.
recognition_signals: the problem asks for the next or previous greater or smaller item
a new value can permanently resolve several earlier candidates
rescanning the suffix for every position would repeat work
core_rules: Every item on the stack is still unresolved.
Pop only when the current item proves the popped candidate's requested boundary or dominance relation.
Each index is pushed and popped at most once.
structural_steps: while the current item resolves the stack top, pop and record that answer
leave any remaining stack entries unresolved when the scan ends

common_confusions.distinction: A monotonic stack resolves candidates according to sequence position and local dominance. A heap returns the current global priority item and does not preserve nearest-position semantics.
